* '''Original''' ([[Knowledge And Defense (V)]]): the Set 0 master PDF captured 6 August 2016, page 6, prints “up to 15 cards” and “may play a Defensive Shield from here”. * '''PC-E1''' ([[Knowledge And Defense (V) (Errata)]]): the Set 0 master PDF captured 4 July 2017, page 4, prints “any number of Defensive Shields” and “may play a card from here”. It prints an “E” mark.<ref name="pc-set0-2017">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Virtual Card Master Set, Set 0], Players Committee, page 4. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704234722/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive], 4 July 2017.</ref>
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Knowledge And Defense (V) (Errata 2)]]): the PC full-card image present by 8 July 2018 has the same game-text wording as the 2017 slip. It prints “E” and the bottom caption “•Knowledge And Defense”. The full-card image includes the upper title, lore and artwork, absent from the PDF cutout.<ref name="pc-knowledge-2018">Players Committee Holotable repository, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b], 8 July 2018.
